name: Spicy Honey Mustard Wings with Radish, Avocado & Cabbage Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes.
About 10 minutes before the wings are done, wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice radishes. Place in a clean large bowl.

Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl with the radish along with shredded cabbage and half of the dressing. Toss to combine the slaw and set aside. (Place remaining dressing in another large bowl and reserve for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
1 cup honey mustard dressing

instructions.primary_message: Add hot sauce to the reserved bowl with the dressing and whisk to combine the sauce.
When the wings are done, remove from oven. Add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
